title.narrative: Improving water, sanitation and hygiene services in health care facilities with sustainable water supplies to serve the most vulnerable populations in Yemen

description.narrative: Improved potable water supply to targeted healthcare facilities serving vulnerable populations Establishment/installation of wells in 10 targeted healthcare facilities (solar well drilling, water pump, connecting pipes and water tank) Provision of potable water supply to 60 healthcare facilities Monitoring and treating water quality in 60 healthcare facilities Training on operation and maintenance of water supply and monitoring of water quality within healthcare facilities for 60 staff in 12 healthcare facilities 2- Improvement of water, sanitation and hygiene services in two healthcare facilities in the governorate Improvement of water quality and quantity, and sanitation facilities that meet the special needs of women (preserving privacy), and people with different abilities; Improvement of water delivery within healthcare facilities, hand hygiene and general environmental hygiene through rehabilitation works in Marib Governorate Hospital and Matna Hospital in Sana’a
Improving water, sanitation and hygiene services in health care facilities with sustainable water supplies to serve the most vulnerable populations in Yemen

Reduce morbidity and mortality among women, girls, boys and men affected by crises from preventable diseases, through improved water, sanitation and hygiene services in health care facilities and improved service delivery in health care facilities through safe water supply
